usage.finalMessage:
I added the `move` command; it uses the same horizon and slot rules as `book` and gives the same errors. `help` and the README now list it right after `cancel`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes all 7 tests, including two new ones in `MoveTests.fs`, and everything is committed.
Two open questions are in the report. First, moving an appointment to the date and time it already has is refused as "already booked", because a new booking there would be. Second, the existing exemption that lets k2 be double-booked has no decision record behind it; I left it alone, and `move` follows it too.

OUTCOME: completed
